title: Collapse chain branches into one business (Tier 2)

tasks.title: showroom_merge_candidates + showroom_merge_candidate_members
tasks.detail: showroom_merge_candidates + showroom_merge_candidate_members + showroom_merge_exclusions. group_key UNIQUE (sorted ACTIVE member store ids). Members relate by store_id FK — no denormalized names. role = KEEPER|BRANCH|EXCLUDED; resulting_location_id set on apply. Exclusions persist an ordered (store_id_lo, store_id_hi) pair so a human exclude decision survives across scans. db:generate then migrate:remote, then verify on remote.

tasks.title: Add unit/suite column to showroom_store_locations
tasks.detail: The locations table cannot express a suite, so any address rebuilt from street_number + street_name is BUILDING-level — that is what nearly merged Leandro Quintal (#64A) into Marblus Granite (#40C) in PR #356, and why locations were reduced to contributing place_id only. After 0047 most branch addresses live ONLY on location rows, so they must be unit-qualifiable before address matching can safely use them again. Add the column, backfill from the parsed store location_address where possible, then re-enable the location address signal in dedup with the unit included.

tasks.title: scan_showroom_merge_candidates — upsert candidates from 0046 detection
tasks.detail: Reuses groupBySignals + the isReal>=2 classification; does NOT reimplement detection. FILTERS showroom_stores to is_active=1 before grouping (a retired branch must never re-enter detection). SKIPS any edge whose endpoints are a persisted excluded pair. Idempotent by group_key; a changed active membership becomes a NEW candidate and the old goes STALE.

tasks.title: services/showroom/collapse-branches.ts
tasks.detail: Per branch: create the location row FIRST, then remap children (reusing 0046 SIMPLE_MOVE/DEDUP_MOVE), then soft-delete the store. Sequential + compensating delete (D1 has no transactions). IDEMPOTENT/RESUMABLE: key each branch on its member resulting_location_id — skip a member that already has one on retry; mark the candidate APPLIED only when every branch completed, else it stays TBD. Re-verify at APPLY that every member is still active and matches group_key; abort STALE if it moved. Skip and report a branch with no usable address. Chunk COLUMN-AWARE at floor(100/columns-per-row), not a fixed 20 — ~90 ids for a single-col FK remap, ~8 rows for a ~12-col location INSERT. EXCLUDED members untouched, their pair written to showroom_merge_exclusions.

tasks.title: list / get / resolve / apply_merge_candidate
tasks.detail: One file per tool. READ_ONLY, READ_ONLY, WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE. Hand-written Zod v4 inputShape validates every id; a keeper/exclude must belong to the named candidate. apply_merge_candidate REFUSES a candidate that is not APPROVED and re-runs the active/group_key re-verify before writing. Registry writes are OAuth/bearer-gated — no unauthenticated path. Gives chat parity with the UI per the ambiguous-parent doctrine.

tasks.title: /admin/shopping/showrooms/merge-review
tasks.detail: Thin Astro shell (class not className, container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-12, header block with a 24px lucide icon) + one React island. Per group: switchable keeper, each member with address/phone/site + matched evidence, per-member keep/exclude, approve/reject.

tasks.title: scripts/qc/pr_<n>.mjs — preview + prod
tasks.detail: Collapse exercised on a throwaway store pair the test creates and removes — never live rows. Asserts: address carried across, children remapped, EXCLUDED member untouched + its pair persisted + not re-proposed, a partial collapse resumes cleanly, apply refuses a non-APPROVED candidate, re-scan yields no new candidate, and 0046 no-runaway-component still passes.

successCriteria: Every 0046 branchCandidate appears as a reviewable candidate row
Approving collapses N stores into 1 business + N locations with no address lost
A member marked EXCLUDED is left completely untouched
Re-running the scan after an apply produces no new candidate for that group
QC green on preview and prod
